_why: DRYDOCK (NIGHT15 U3-28.6; MAP-DESIGN.md sections 3.1 and 4): "Finish the ship, or fight on its bones." A sky-shipyard cut into a cliff at dusk, the last airship half-built in its cradle. The hub, THE CRADLE, is THE RING: a 172 m training loop around the unfinished hull and its 64 m mast (the landmark, seen from every zone), cut in two by the keel corridor, with aimed pads up to the hull deck; each side zone is built for its verbs (THE RIBS: a canyon of 8-12 m slabs 7 m apart to wall-ride and wall-jump; THE SLIPWAY: two 40 m launch ramps down from a 10 m deck and a pad back up), and THE GANGWAY is the start, the mast in view through its door. Tonight's greybox builds these four zones; the boilerworks, the drafting office, the gantry and the pier are night 2. New design, so Unity-side (CLAUDE.md rule 5: the web never had this map); every number comes from Design/maps/drydock.plan.json, sized from the movement numbers in MAP-DESIGN.md section 1, and Assets/Editor/Maps/Build_drydock.cs turns it into this file. The map's identity is GG's decision (D-59): this is the recommended concept, built to be played and judged.
name: n38-span

navGrid.columnCenter: column c: x = origin + (c % size + 0.5) * cell, z = origin + (floor(c / size) + 0.5) * cell

nodes.note: parallel arrays, one entry per node (index = node id). x, z: the column centre; y: floor height; clear: headroom to the next surface above (m); tag: zone index (-1: none); edge: 1 when a floor is missing under one side of the body; col: column index; blocked: all 0 at build (locked zones are masked at run time by tag)

links.note: CSR: node i's links are linkStart[i] .. linkStart[i + 1] - 1; linkTo = target node, linkKind = linkKinds value, linkCost = m-equivalent cost

navGrid.tagAt: zoneIndexAt(zoneParts.parts, x, y + 1, z), as survival/zones.js tagAt

rooms.name: 4.1 STITCH YARD
rooms.verb36: the STITCHER (hold to stream) + the first pull
rooms.grapple: ONE ring over the terrace's front edge at 9 m: a pull from the floor lands you on the terrace among the spitters

rooms.name: 4.2 FIRST GAP
rooms.verb36: look up and pull: one gate
rooms.respawnY_why: a fall into the void is back at the room's start (Campaign24's respawnY, a share of health: design.n29.roomRules.fallCostFraction): 1 m of drop under the take-off is already a miss, so no move but the pull lives long enough over the void to cross it

pull38._why: the flight room's gates for the walk pilot (Bot/Walk38Span.cs): each gate's lip (the take-off edge), its ring and the landing point (world metres)

rooms.grapple: ONE ring 5 m over the landing, 3 m past its lip: from the pier's lip, look up and PULL

rooms.name: 4.3 KNOT YARD
rooms.verb36: pulls between balconies in a fight; kills give pulls
rooms.grapple: FOUR rings in a diamond at 10 m over the floor: ring to balcony to ring, while the swarmers chase (a kill gives a pull back)

rooms.name: 4.4 PULL LINE
rooms.verb36: two rising gates, one charge each
rooms.respawnY_why: a fall into the void is back at the room's start (Campaign24's respawnY, a share of health: design.n29.roomRules.fallCostFraction): 1 m of drop under the take-off is already a miss, so no move but the pull lives long enough over the void to cross it

pull38._why: the flight room's gates for the walk pilot (Bot/Walk38Span.cs): each gate's lip (the take-off edge), its ring and the landing point (world metres)

rooms.grapple: TWO rings, one over each landing: pull up to pier B, run its 12 m, pull up to pier C (one charge each: the second gate spends the last one)

rooms.name: 4.5 SPOOL HALL
rooms.grapple: TWO rings at 10 m: one in front of the gallery (pull up level with the spitters, whip one off), one over the west lane toward the exit

rooms.name: 4.8 THREAD LINE
rooms.respawnY_why: a fall into the void is back at the room's start (Campaign24's respawnY, the share of health design.n29.roomRules.fallCostFraction): rehearsal, not punishment
rooms.grapple: two threads: one over the void before the tower (pull 1), one over the far ledge (pull 2, from the tower's ride or its top)

rooms.name: 4.9 SWING ANCHOR
rooms.verb36: pull to a moving anchor + nail a knee and pull away (the tear)
rooms.respawnY_why: a fall into the void is back at the room's start (Campaign24's respawnY, the share of health design.n29.roomRules.fallCostFraction): rehearsal, not punishment
rooms.grapple: the SWING ANCHOR (node 1: Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs moves it east-west), a thread over the post (node 2), the far thread over the exit ledge (node 3)

loomSwing37._why: the anchor's swing: +- ampX m east-west about its rest, one period in periodS (design.n37.loom37.swingAmpM / swingPeriodS win when present)

kneeTarget37.why: the practice knee: nail it from the post, then pull away to the far thread (node 3): the nails tear it (a cyan burst)

rooms.name: 4.10 THE CANYON
rooms.verb36: grapple crossing + nail and tear (the exam)
rooms.respawnY_why: the campaign's fallback only: with design.n37.loom37 on, Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs catches a fall first (feet under design.n37.loom37.fallY) and puts the player on the last anchor ledge for -20 HP
rooms.grapple: THREAD ANCHORS (BOSSES.md L4): one pair before each tower pair and one pair over each tower top (the anchor ledges), one over the end ledge; THE LOOM's six knees join them as moving nodes for the fight (Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs) and it cuts the ones behind it

loom37._why: THE CANYON's data for Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs (builder O): anchors = the room's grappleNodes in order (id, pair, the ledge under it); ledges = the anchor ledges (a fall comes back to the last one stood on); stations = where THE LOOM hangs for each leg (leg 3 = the nest); webWalls = the sheet each leg can weave between a tower pair (a layer swap); all world metres

rank._why: Unity-only (builder O2, NIGHT38): NIGHT30's S/A/B/C cuts kept for level 4 (n37-span's); NOT calibrated on the n38 rooms (the walk bot's times come first).
